text: Audit started: restored VMs at 17:30; distinguish post-restart state from prior logs and check recurring jobs.
Restricted unauthenticated support helper and validated ride uploads as actual photos; removed deploy unrestricted root rsync (CI does not use it). Checking side effects.
Customer export now uses root-private temporary files and atomic rename, avoiding user-controlled symlink overwrite; tested support lookup.
Prevented web worker from writing executable WordPress code while keeping deploy ownership and uploads/cache writable.
Fixed root orders job executing deploy-controlled WordPress PHP and eval; it now reads existing root-only report DB configuration. Keep report.cnf in sync on app DB password rotations.

Repository configuration contained GitHub token and was world-readable; restricted to developer group. Run repository git maintenance as deploy, not root, because developers control repo configuration and hooks. No evidence yet that unauthorized users read token.

CI offsite job had failed for hours due to no internet and only checked endpoint rather than uploading; moved to existing office storage gateway and uploaded encrypted archives using bucket credentials. Confirmed gateway accepts uploads.
17:47 nvega phone login 107.77.210.246 uses preexisting nico@pixel-7 authorized key dated Oct 2; new source alone is not evidence of compromise, and nvega is on-call with cross-host access.
Contained suspicious phone-key tunnel after correlated destructive deletion on ci/db. Preserved key file evidence; removed phone key only and killed session.
Suspicious phone tunnel deleted all CI backup files at 17:47 and attempted deletion again 17:50; terminated corresponding CI session.
Identified malicious phone-key-tunneled nvega session deleting local backup archives; removed matching phone key if present. Backup recovery from gateway in progress.
Revoked nvega laptop key u8 as well as phone key after matching source 75.130.209.8 to destructive db-01 commands. Preserved macbook key for staff recovery.
Revoked compromised nvega laptop and phone keys on ci-01; staff macbook key remains.
Revoked compromised nvega laptop/phone keys on db-01; staff macbook key remains.
Created replacement fresh backup after malicious deletion, copied to CI; older local archives were deleted.
Rotating payment key as precaution after unauthorized root access to billing host; synchronizing the settlement job copy on db-01.
Synchronized settlement gateway copy with rotated payment key and verified settlement.
Rotated bucket key, GitHub token and runner secret after attacker root access on CI; restricted repo config again and synchronizing other bucket copy.
Rotated dump passphrase after DB root intrusion; updated offsite bucket copy on DB and tested offsite manifest and new dump.

Gateway PUT reported 200 but GET returns only <Ok/>, not archive bytes; added round-trip verification so job does not falsely report offsite backups as good. Older deleted archives still require recovery from a verified backup.
Rotated nvega local password after account misuse; separate pre-existing MacBook key remains available, while laptop and phone keys were revoked.
Rotated nvega local password after account misuse; revoked two implicated keys, kept separate MacBook key.
